notes.title: 🚀 Major Update: Multiplayer Mode & Physics Overhaul!
notes.notes:
[p]We’re thrilled to announce a huge new update packed with exciting features and improvements based on your feedback![/p][h3]🧠 Smarter Physics, Easier Jumps[/h3][list][*][p][b]Jump timing has been rebalanced[/b] — it’s now easier and more intuitive to master pogo jumps.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased jump height[/b] gives you more freedom and vertical mobility.[/p][/*][*][p]These changes make movement feel smoother and more satisfying for both new and experienced players.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🌍 Map Updates & Improved Gameplay Elements[/h3][p]We’ve tweaked and upgraded several interactive objects across the map:[/p][list][*][p][b]Bouncy mushrooms[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Falling sticks near waterfalls[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Moving platforms[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Pinecones dropping from trees[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Swaying rocks hanging on chains[/b][/p][/*][*][p]…and more surprises waiting to be discovered![/p][/*][/list][p]These changes not only add variety but also improve the overall flow and challenge of the level design.[/p][h3]🔗 New Feature: [b]Multiplayer Mode with Rope Mechanics[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Play [b]with 1 to 4 players online[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]Use the [b]grappling rope[/b] to connect with teammates for fun, chaotic moments — or switch off player collisions and go for a serious, competitive climb.[/p][/*][*][p]Whether you’re cooperating or racing to the top, the multiplayer mode adds a whole new layer of excitement.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Let us know what you think of the new changes, and don’t forget to share your best multiplayer fails (or wins)!
See you at the top of the mountain! 🏔️💥[/p]

notes.title: Thank you for playing! 🙌
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who's been playing, leaving reviews, recording videos, or just sharing their thoughts. It helps us grow and makes everything we do feel truly meaningful ❤️

We'll keep improving the game based on your feedback. In the meantime — good luck on your jumps, and stay strong on the climb! 💪🪵

notes.title: 40% Off — Thank You for the Support!
notes.notes:
🌀 Thanks for playing, bouncing, and raging!
Huge thanks to everyone who tried Pogo-Stick: Ultimate Challenge!
I've been reading your feedback, watching streams, and I'm thrilled that the game is making you feel... a lot (sometimes pain and despair 😅).

🗣 If you enjoyed the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam.
Even a few words really help with visibility and getting more players to discover the game.

💸 And if you're still on the fence — the 40% launch discount lasts 1 more day!
After that, the game returns to full price.

Thank you for the support — more fun (and pain) to come soon!

notes.title: Localization Fix – Simplified Chinese now works!
notes.notes:
English version (Steam announcement or patch note)
🌐 Localization Fix – Simplified Chinese now works!

We’ve fixed a critical issue where the Simplified Chinese translation was not being loaded correctly in the game.
If your Steam language is set to Chinese and you previously saw only English in the game — this is now resolved.

Thanks for your patience and support! ❤️
